sentence_stem: Of all the mountains we visited,
full_sentence: Of all the mountains we visited, this one was the highest.
acceptable_variants: this one was the most impressive.

options.text: we took many photos along the way.
options.why_wrong: This describes the trip but does not compare the mountains with each other, so the superlative structure is not completed.
This is a general description of one trail. It does not compare the mountains, so the superlative link is missing.

options.text: it was more high than the others.
options.why_wrong: 'More high' is ungrammatical here. When comparing three or more items, the superlative form 'the highest' is required.

grammar_focus: Superlative adjectives with 'the' for comparing three or more items
explanation: The phrase 'of all the mountains' compares one item against every other item in a group of three or more. Superlative adjectives such as 'the highest' express that comparison, and learners often forget the word 'the' before them.
translation: Ziyaret ettiğimiz bütün dağlar arasında bu en yüksek olanıydı.
